declare @DatetoProcessed  datetime
set @DatetoProcessed = '2024-01-17'

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER;
END;

WITH
CustomerSK
as (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimCustomer 
),
CustomerRelatedParty as(
	SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty where @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 
),
CustomerMaritalStatus as(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartdate desc  ) rn, CustomerId, MaritalStatusId from BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE @DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and convert(date,replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') )
),
AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer as(
SELECT DISTINCT RelatedCustomerId FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer where @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 
),
CustomerAccountMBK as(
	SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'MBK'
),
CustomerAccountRIB as(
	SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'RIB'
),
BusinessOnlineBankingAccount as(
	SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount
),
CustomerAccountParticipation as(
	SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
    JOIN BusinessOnlineBankingAccount BOBA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BOBA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP','LNS')
)

,
DCTemp as(
     SELECT DISTINCT
 BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,BIC.IndividualCustomerName AS CustomerName
,CASE WHEN BCT.CustomerTypeName = 'Individual' THEN 'Retail' ELSE BCT.CustomerTypeName END  AS CustomerType
,BIC.DateOfBirth AS DateOfBirth
,BMS.MaritalStatusName AS MaritalStatus
,BG.GenderName AS Gender
,TMPCCS.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,TMPCCS.Email AS Email
,TMPCCS.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,TMPCCS.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,TMPCCS.City AS City
,TMPCCS.Province AS Province
,TMPCCS.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,TMPCCS.Country AS Country
,TMPCCS.Nationality AS Nationality
,TMPCCS.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent --change to null due to issue in duplicate for customer consent
,TMPCCS.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,TMPCCS.SuspendedIndicator AS SuspendedIndicator
,BC.CustomerEstablishedDate AS RelationshipStartDate
,BCRP.PartyId AS GlobalCIF
,CASE WHEN BCRC.RelatedCustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,CASE WHEN BCA.CustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator --MBK
,CASE WHEN BCA2.CustomerId IS NOT NULL OR BCAP.CoreCustomerId IS NOT NULL 
THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator --RIB/BOB
,GenerationalCohortSK AS GenerationalCohortSK
,TMPCCS.EmployerName
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine1
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine2
,TMPCCS.OfficeCity
,TMPCCS.OfficeProvince
,TMPCCS.OfficeZipCode
,TMPCCS.OfficeCountry
,TMPCCS.Industry
,TMPCCS.Occupation
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,BC.BranchId AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,convert(date,'9999-12-31') AS ValidEndDate
,BC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Customer BC
JOIN DW.DimCustomer_CRM TMPCCS ON BC.CustomerId = TMPCCS.CUSTOMERID AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = TMPCCS.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.IndividualCustomer BIC ON BC.CustomerId  = BIC.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN CustomerRelatedParty  BCRP ON BC.CustomerId = BCRP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCRP.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerType BCT ON BC.CustomerTypeId= CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCT.CustomerTypeId) AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN CustomerMaritalStatus BCMS ON BC.CustomerId = BCMS.CustomerId and BCMS.RN=1

LEFT JOIN BNKM.MaritalStatus BMS ON BCMS.MaritalStatusId  = convert(varchar,BMS.MaritalStatusId)
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Gender BG ON BIC.GenderId = convert(varchar,BG.GenderId)

LEFT JOIN AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer BCRC ON BC.CustomerId = BCRC.RelatedCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountMBK BCA ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerId)  --MBK
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountRIB BCA2 ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA2.CustomerId)  --RIB
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BC.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimGenerationalCohort DGC ON YEAR(BIC.DateOfBirth)>= DGC.LowerLimit  AND YEAR(BIC.DateOfBirth) <= DGC.UpperLimit 
WHERE BC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
)
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM CustomerSK)  AS CustomerSK , *  into DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER FROM DCTemp
